verdict.rationale: Docs describe pre-request scripts for manipulating requests/variables and the ability to chain requests by extracting values from other responses (insomnia-docs-1, insomnia-docs-2, insomnia-docs-21), backed by environment variables and a Collection Runner for ordered execution (insomnia-docs-9, insomnia-docs-20). However, a hands-on community comparison explicitly calls out Insomnia's 'garbage-tier glue code support, something that was very much missing coming from Postman' (insomnia-comm-15), directly contradicting the claim of robust scripting for chaining/data massaging. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that pre/post-request scripting works reliably in practice, and resolution of the contradicting hands-on report.
